'''Axel Danhausen''' won the [[1997 Ralltiir Regionals (Copenhagen)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I am 28 and a physics student, living in Aachen, a city near Cologne, Germany. My hobbies are working with my PC (not only playing) and playing CCGs like Star Wars CCG and Magic: The Gathering. I have many favourite movies. Here are just a few of them: ''Silence of the Lambs'', ''Highlander I'', ''To Have and Have Not'', and of course, the Star Wars Trilogy. With best regards."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/danhausen.html Axel Danhausen], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427163211/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/danhausen.html Internet Archive]</ref>
